proves.claim: A submit merge of a 60-file main move written as objects leaves git status empty and HEAD unchanged.

cli.journeys-submit-nomerge.a-sixty-file.why: Without it, a submit that checks out a big main move would leave the item folder changed under the builder.

proves.claim: A second submit merge from the same folder is not refused DIRTY and composes the same tree.

cli.journeys-submit-nomerge.a-second-sub.why: Without it, a folder left dirty by the first submit would refuse the second.
